capacity_closure_registration_contract.claim_boundary: A one-future-visit 95% joint upper-time audit and conditional local complete-frame capacity calculation for the registered gpu_b nine-action catalogue. It is not time-uniform physical coverage, a trajectory result, or candidate-search closure without separate same-model static support evidence.

uniform_margin_scaling_audit.joint_score_implication: the maximum of the nine registered functional ratio scores simultaneously bounds every component; summing the two loaded components therefore preserves the same multiplier

model_contract.duration_catalogue: the capacity-closure nine-action complete-frame envelope rebuilt from the frozen predictor anchor and final rank-19 joint margin
model_contract.synthetic_lane_rule: replicate the same hardware-local lane option catalogue without adding a physical multi-GPU interference claim

physical_load_contract.eta_formula: max_w min_i[R*sum_a w_a requirements[a,i]/max(1,tau_joint95[a]) - lambda_R(load)[i]] - projection_support_loss_R
physical_load_contract.reason: the registered loads are redefined relative to the final physical joint-envelope common boundary

selector_contract.candidate: one fresh count-space B&B call per state at the fixed budget
selector_contract.reference: one separate cold count-space B&B K4096 call per state
selector_contract.support_gate: for every R/load case both eta-max(candidate_epsilon) and eta-max(actual_normalized_action_regret) exceed 1e-10
selector_contract.certificate_gate: every candidate and reference reconstructs; every returned bound is valid; every K4096 reference is exact; actual regret is nonnegative and no larger than returned epsilon
selector_contract.actual_compute_gate: for each lane and in aggregate, fixed-budget totals are strictly below cold-reference totals for LP calls, LP matrix coefficients, and candidate evaluations
selector_contract.enumeration_gate: ordered-action evaluations and count-vector enumerations both equal zero

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more registered execution checks fail
decision_rule.STATIC_SUPPORT_AND_COMPUTE_PASS_ADVANCE_: R8/K36 and R16/K72 both have valid finite-roster certificates, actual action regret and returned epsilon strictly below eta at all three physical-capacity-normalized loads, and strictly lower aggregate LP, matrix, and candidate-evaluation work than their cold K4096 references
decision_rule.STATIC_SUPPORT_FAIL_STOP: at least one registered lane/load support residual is nonpositive
decision_rule.STATIC_COMPUTE_FAIL_STOP: support passes, but at least one actual-compute comparison is not strict

claim_boundary: An exhaustive comparison on one independently generated and preregistered 512-base-queue roster for synthetic identical-lane R8 and R16 replicas of the joint-95 gpu_b complete-frame envelope. It is conditional on the registered one-future-visit joint coverage audit and is not an all-queue theorem, failure-rate estimate, physical multi-GPU trajectory, stability proof, or deployment decision. A pass advances only to a separately registered physical-time trajectory experiment.
prohibited: reading joint visit values, the joint result ledger, or the capacity-closure outcome during registration; changing the queue roster, loads, budgets, reference, duration composition, or gates after joint95 outcomes; ordered-action or count-vector enumeration; run-time RNG; arrivals or trajectories; server pulls; and paper edits
